availability: Unknown historical dissemination/correction availability remains unknown; retain actual capture timestamps.

baseline.verification: Every payload and document SHA256 read back from pinned native publication; historical available_at remains null.

checks: Exact eligible-trade vs retained SIP daily and published volume
IBKR full-day volume, condition-size multisets, exact price-size-condition multisets and unmatched records

clock_contract: Use published exchange calendar for early close. Whole-day volume remains New York midnight to next midnight; do not call 09:30-16:00 a regular session on this date.
minute_bars: No new minute bars required for this full-day volume question.
retained_daily_values: Pinned prior SIP publication and local WRDS comparison; licensed rows stay outside Git.
retention: Retain all source responses locally with query/capture/code hashes; compact findings in Git.
reuse_decision: New frozen scope adapter reuses unchanged capture/reconciliation helpers; no existing recipe, service or registered asset is modified.

rules.combination: Most restrictive rule; unknown tape/condition/update state fails closed. Nasdaq B is bunched trade (price eligible), W is average-price (price ineligible).

scope: Single largest absolute CRSP/SIP discrepancy; independent full-day and actual early-close clock inspection.
selection: Maximum absolute CRSP vs SIP volume percentage difference among the 2277 identifier-qualified rows. Diagnostic selection made before these trade downloads.
